title: Polo Noban Ka Kalatas
author: Traditional
content:
{title: Polo Noban Ka Kalatas}

{comment: Verse 1}
Polo no ban ka kalatas,
Piny nowang` nodong` gunda;
Polo noban ka wadhiye edala manyien,
Polo noban ka kalatas
Polo noban ka kalatas

{comment: Verse 2}
Jwar nobi giduuuong` malich,
Jolweny nomor ka ginere;
Jawar nolor gi ler marieny kaka wang` chieng`
Jomolocho nodonji emor
Jomolocho nodonji emor

{comment: Verse 3}
Asinde polo noywagi,
Ka wadnjo Jerusalem.
Tunge noywagi ka waromo edala manyien,
Wanawerie wende locho
Wanawerie wende locho

{comment: Verse 4}
To pi wang` wa Yesu noywe,
Osimb loch enosidhnwa.
To wanachiem gi Yesu Ruoth e mas maduong`
Ka kuyo duto oserumo
Ka kuyo duto oserumo

{comment: Verse 5}
Onge mudho epolo ku,
Nyasaye wuonwa eler marieny;
To Yesu Ruoth e tac sayun-Ruodwa mang`won,
Wananene kobet ekom
Wananene kobet ekom
